steps.sql: SELECT REGEXP_COUNT('x','.',1,CAST('c' AS char(1))) AS n;
SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR('x','.',1,1,CAST('c' AS char(1))) AS s;
SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('x','.',1,1,0,CAST('c' AS char(1))) AS n;
SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE('x','.','y',1,0,CAST('c' AS char(1))) AS s;
SELECT CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE('x','.',CAST('c' AS char(1))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n;
SELECT * FROM REGEXP_MATCHES('x','.',CAST('c' AS char(1)));
